reviews.text:
Most professional and honest vet I finally found!
The front desk are also very kind and welcoming.

Couldnt recommend them enough.

Our dog started showing abnormal symptoms overnight and they were able to give us an appointment on the same day after calling.

We really appreciate how gentle and caring everyone was with Puffy, happy to have such a great clinic in our neighborhood. Thank you for explaining everything in detail and easing our minds!
Great practice!

Hello Natalia,

Thank you for your lovely review. It motivates us to do our best every day.

Kind regards,

Europaplein Veterinary Clinic - Amsterdam

Hello Nadine,

Thank you for your lovely review. We are happy that your experience was positive.
Kind regards,
Dierenkliniek Europaplein

Good morning Andrea,

Thank you for your positive review. That means a lot to our team.

Kind regards,

Europaplein Veterinary Clinic Amsterdam
Lovely friendly animal centric vets!
Very helpful and friendly staff
Very professional, friendly and considerate. Well planned and fair feedback on options.

We are so happy with every single person who works at this pet clinic! The amount of love and care these wonderful people put into their work is amazing. The doctors are very patient explaining every little detail and have helped us a bunch already. Our dog even loves coming by because he always gets treats and is made feel comfortable there. Thank you!
Excellent team of veterinarians and assistants! And very kind and caring towards the owners.
fantastic staff

I want to share this horrible experience.

I am extremely disappointed and deeply upset by the way my dog was treated during what was supposed to be a simple ultrasound procedure.

Her belly was aggressively shaved, and even her nipples were shaved, which was completely unnecessary and shocking. Her skin was scratched and visibly damaged, and since that day she has been in severe pain for three days. Instead of recovery, I now have to care for her and treat the consequences of how carelessly she was handled.

The staff member who performed this procedure showed no care, no empathy, and no basic respect for animals. This level of roughness was not professional — it was cruel.

I have been visiting this clinic before and always had excellent experiences with other doctors. However, this particular vet was absolutely terrible. She unnecessarily shaved my dog’s belly and nipples, scratched her skin, and now my dog has been in severe pain for three days. I am attaching photos so others can see the results.
We came with our sweet Rosso for an emergency appointment because our vet didn't have time. We were helped in a very professional and loving manner.
The vet was super nice to us, super patient and explained everything. Checked my cat properly and gave a  solution. Thank you very much!
friendly and knowledgeable staff
Friendly and professional. Treatment in good consultation after clear explanation.
Friendly staff with a lot of knowledge and professionalism.
Great, fast, and clear service; call on Tuesday, appointment on Wednesday. Nothing to complain about.
Human and animal friendly clinic

Very friendly staff, very knowledgeable. It was hard to find a vet for my water turtle. He was super helpful and even helped me with sending me a dietery schedule and lots of info that I needed. Thank you

Since I recently (cat corona really exists it seems) brought a 3rd kitten for sterilization to the animal-loving Europaplein clinic and was actually able to pick up Knurft a little while later and the procedure and recovery were again (almost pleasantly) carried out so perfectly and simply, I really don't have to think for a second about where I will have the 4th cat sterilized (this time for someone else)... Europaplein animal clinic.... that's where I (again) have to be... photos and report to follow... greetings Wilf Noway
A very friendly and professional practice. I have been a very satisfied customer for 15 years.

Clearly, the people working here have a heart for animals.

Our cat Juno had an inflamed eye and was lovingly examined and treated by veterinarian Cosimo, who calmly took the time to figure out all the important matters.
I would wholeheartedly refer friends with pets to this practice.
Very animal-friendly and professional. The clinic has a pleasant atmosphere, and they treat my cat and me as a client with care. The journey is no problem.

Note: This clinic has been bought by Evidensia, an investor who pressures veterinarians and owners to increase profits. I experienced this firsthand when I visited with my cat once; I had to pay over €200 for a blood test (the cat turned out to be completely healthy...). My advice: avoid it and find an independent clinic.
Our Boef didn't like coming here, but he was always helped wonderfully. The farewell on April 11th, at almost 16 years old, was respectful and well arranged. Thanks again for all the great help!
I am happy for my dog ​​for the always pleasant and professional good care at the practice.

Really good experience for our first time here. We were assisted by a wonderful gentleman (I believe an Italian man but sadly don't have his name) who took very good care of our cat Lulu and explained everything in detail to us. Thank you for the wonderful and caring service
A high-quality veterinary clinic. The staff are available and very pleasant.
There is a specialist in rabbits. She is an excellent vet and an ethical professional. Highly recommended.

Very kind, friendly, patient staff. My dog was seen by Mihel and Bianca, they were very gentle and caring with my 13 year old Yorkiepoo. I don’t live in Amsterdam but was very grateful they could see me dog in such short notice whilst I was travelling through the Netherlands. Highly recommended!
Received excellent and expert assistance
Very good, reliable, fantastic staff, a heart for animals and very knowledgeable!!!!!
I’m bringing my do to Cosimo and he his the sweetest and professional vet, couldn’t do better choice, 10/10!!!
Very friendly, patient, and skilled veterinarians with animal-friendly rates!

My two dogs couldn't be better taken care of. Unfortunately they have had a rough time lately, both my babies are old (12/14) and the doctors here are the most patient and loving.
I deeply appreciated their help and professionalism.
Good vet where you can go quickly

This is a great clinic, I highly recommended.

They take time with the diagnosis and really care about each animal. They’re easy to reach and communication is easy with their booking system and they respond to emails and calls the same day. The vet we saw is very detailed and helpful and got us the right treatment.

Thank you again.
